description: PAID: $0.25 USDC per call on Base (x402), charged only for valid input. Deterministic FX exposure analysis. Computes gross/net exposure, currency concentration, natural hedges, stress scenarios, and hedge priority from a list of receivable/ payable/cash positions by currency. Requires USDC payment via the x402 protocol (Circle Gateway) — see the 402 response for the payment flow. All figures are computed deterministically (no LLM). Call get_example_input first if unsure of the shape.

fxRates.description: Units of baseCurrency per 1 unit of each foreign currency present in `positions`.

stressShockPct.description: Fractional depreciation applied to each foreign currency in the stress scenario.

totalTreasuryValueBase.description: Optional total treasury value (in baseCurrency) used to normalize the risk score. Defaults to total gross FX exposure if omitted.

name: fx_exposure
